generation.CrystalFormer_sample_attempts_interpreta: Conservatively charged CrystalFormer reservation slots, not the number of emitted model draws. Unemitted slots remain charged after a failed reservation; use cohort evidence to identify actual draws. The Phase3 early cohort charged 12 slots for 8 actual draws plus 4 unemitted engineering slots.
generation.timing_scope: cumulative_sampling_seconds and cumulative_run_seconds_including_initialization_and_conversion retain only the measured Phase1 baseline captured in Phase2; they are not total timings for later sampling. cumulative_new_job_wall_seconds sums finished post-baseline generation-job walltime, including failures and recovery. Phase3 pure sampling time was not completely recovered and must not be inferred from these totals.

chgnet.charging_rule: Conservatively count every launch, including four guard rejections before model imports; charge entire subprocess walltime, including imports, load and relaxation.

budget_ledger.note: Canonical state reconstructed from immutable Phase2 totals plus append-only runtime reservations. Counts are charged before dispatch; unfinished runtime reservations remain unavailable. Every failed/retried job is retained.

phase4_end_budget.scope: Historical Phase4 close. Future Phase5 ledgers may advance; this snapshot remains unchanged.

scope: Hashes of sources, frozen commitments, per-round fit/model/reveal evidence, generation/QE artifacts, gates, handoffs and final documents read by this audit. Oracle labels are excluded.
